summary: 1934 CCC-built enclosed timber lookout on the Klamath NF; the forest sought removal around 2016-2017 and a May 2025 visit found it near collapse.

notes_for_editor: Staffing, fire history and public access were not found in any source read; the access level is left out of facts for that reason. The record's line that FFLA began coordinating with the forest is only partly supported: the FFLA report describes SHPO coordination and an interest in an MOU with the FFLA. The record's 'FFLA began coordinating' wording may be worth tightening. The FFLA report's year is taken from its filename (2025) and its text says only 'this summer'. The design text keeps the Register's wording '10 foot enclosed timber tower', which may describe the cab rather than total height, so no height_m is given. A Klamath NF Facebook post mentions ALERTCalifornia cameras at the historic lookout; the post was not readable, so it is not used. The Register's photos (credited to the Nancy Hood Collection and the Siskiyou County Historical Society) have no URLs captured, so no photos are added.
